title: 歩道用ガードパネル
description: 支柱、縦格子、固定金具、連結タブを備える歩行者用の独立した柵パネル。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A standalone powder-coated pedestrian guard panel with steel pickets, foot plates, anchor bolts and joining tabs. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
